profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Consumer & Community Banking -

Developed and optimized ETL pipelines and reporting solutions using Spring Boot and Apache Spark, reducing processing time by 40% for clients like S&P
and Moody's.

Led testing improvements for Java Spark reports, increasing test coverage, resolving critical issues, and enhancing system stability.

Contributed to reducing Kubernetes cluster costs by optimizing resource usage, improving scaling strategies, and streamlining workload
distribution.
positions.insights: Skills: Apache Spark · Java Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Testing · Kubernetes · Python · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · PySpark · Databricks Products

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Auto Navigator Platform -

Designed and implemented a highly scalable Lambda@Edge function using Node.js to enable dynamic image compression and resizing for Auto Navigator’s frontend image assets. This resulted in a significant reduction in S3 storage costs.

Developed a set of scalable RESTful stock media APIs using Spring Boot, facilitating the deployment of more than 5,000 vehicle landing pages on Auto Navigator’s website. Additionally, these APIs granted business partners access to a vast collection of vehicle images.

Spearheaded the implementation of a real-time vehicle media data streaming pipeline, incorporating critical applications to efficiently fetch, download, and populate vehicle media into Auto Navigator’s media inventory. Leveraged Apache Kafka, Amazon Aurora, and Spring Boot to ensure seamless data flow and processing.

Significant hands on experience with AWS cloud services including RDS, DynamoDB, EC2, ECS, SQS, SES, Aurora, CloudFront, ECS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis, SQS and more.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · Maven · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Apache Kafka · Splunk · Node.js · Scala · Grafana · Spring Boot · JUnit · Javascript · Jira · Amazon Aurora · Jenkins · Docker Products · DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed an ETL data pipeline using Spring Boot to seamlessly interface with existing Farmer’s customer policies. This implementation effectively automated a previously manual Excel workflow, resulting in significant time savings by eliminating hours of manual effort.

Utilized Java EE to successfully implement new features and provide ongoing maintenance for Java Enterprise web applications utilized by insurance agents across the nation.

Leveraged JavaScript to develop interactive user interfaces and JSPs that provide rich user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Python · Maven · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Spring Boot · Java EE · Jenkins · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a dynamic REST web application by leveraging Salesforce triggers, Apex, and Javascript. This application extended customer functionality to CRM tenants, enhancing their overall experience.

Designed and implemented a custom Slack integration using Salesforce REST libraries and Slack webhooks into Workday’s Salesforce CRM. This integration empowered support analysts to efficiently share open customer cases via Slack messages and channels, improving collaboration and productivity.

Optimized web application for responsive mobile‑first use using Bootstrap and scalable pagination tables in jQuery for efficient front‑end data rendering.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Salesforce · Slack · Bootstrap

positions.title: eCommerce Web Developer
positions.description:
Successfully implemented and scaled a Magento eCommerce web store hosting a vast catalog of over 5,000 products.

Collaborated closely with business partners to design and develop eCommerce functionality for the web store, utilizing HTML, JavaScript, and PHP.

Achieved a notable reduction in frontend assets render time, optimizing performance by up to 50%.

positions.title: Student Mentor
positions.description:
10 week non‑profit leadership program teaching at‑risk underrepresented teens the software development skills and fundamentals of building startups to better help their community.

Served as project lead while providing mentorship to a 4 person team that developed an MVP for a community based application.

Held programming workshops and helped organize program events.
